items.title: WuXi AppTec hits back after being named in Pentagon’s Chinese military list
items.summary: A spokesperson for the Chinese company said “we will take immediate action” following the military designation.

items.title: ADA26: Oral PCSK9 inhibitor enlicitide delivers robust LDL-C lowering
items.summary: Phase III data suggest oral PCSK9 inhibitor enlicitide delivers substantial LDL-C lowering without compromising glycemic control.

items.title: ADA26: Early data for teplizumab demonstrates promise for slowing T1D progression
items.summary: Real-world data presented at ADA 2026 showcased the impact of Sanofi's teplizumab in slowing type 1 diabetes (T1D) progression.

items.title: GSK doubles down on oncology with $10.6bn Nuvalent takeover
items.summary: Nuvalent’s two late-stage lung cancer assets – zidesamtinib and neladalkib – are currently under FDA review

items.title: J&J to acquire Firefly Bio for $1bn to enhance oncology pipeline
items.summary: J&J has agreed to buy Firefly Bio for $1bn in cash, aiming to strengthen its oncology pipeline with Firefly Bio’s Firelink DAC platform.
